caption: The video depicts an outdoor scene on dry, pale grass where a small block of cardboard burns with a bright orange-yellow flame. The flame is already active and continues to flicker, rising as a single tall tongue, splitting into two prongs, and curling into looping shapes that lean left or right toward a hand-drawn cardboard tower marked with brick and arched-window lines. Its base remains anchored at the central burning block throughout. To the left lies a heap of gray, curled, already-burnt corrugated cardboard that stays static in shape and position. The drawn box and the flat cardboard base sheet hold their fixed positions, showing no new charring or collapse. A faint white smoke plume drifts slowly along the right edge of the base and behind the box.
relations: Flame flickers and rises from the central block, splitting into prongs and curling toward the drawn tower.
The grey burnt corrugated heap stays static in shape and position beside the flame.
The drawn box and flat base sheet remain fixed with no new charring or collapse.
Faint white smoke drifts slowly along the right edge of the base behind the box.
